title: An uncontrolled recursion in the MessagePack\BufferUnpacker::unpack() component of rybakit/msgpack v0.11.0 allows…
description: An uncontrolled recursion vulnerability exists in the MessagePack\BufferUnpacker::unpack() component of rybakit/msgpack version 0.11.0. This flaw allows attackers to cause a Denial of Service (DoS) by providing specially crafted input.
